series.label: 4.12 mg/kg
series.evidence:
Mouse IT 4.12 mg/kg: ELF observed mean curve; - PMB; mouse; IT; single 4.12 mg/kg at time 0. Matrix: ELF; plotted mean, not individual records.
- DIGITIZED from observed markers, not fitted lines. Concentration and pixel time are approximate; no SD or individual IDs recovered.
- Image calibration x=145,1085 -> 0,12 h; y=37,696 -> 10^3,10^0 mg/L; origin top-left.
- Sensitivity allowance +/-2 pixels is a digitization tolerance, NOT a confidence interval or biological SD.
- Neutropenic P. aeruginosa lung-infected mice; dose in mg BASE/kg; nominal times from PK methods; terminal samples.
- Caption mean+/-SD, n>=3; methods n=4/time. Source means do not establish repeated individual-animal IDs.
- Plasma total only: exclude the separately plotted calculated unbound copy to avoid counting observations twice.
- Same-study plasma fu=0.046 is an assay-based mean with no numeric uncertainty recovered. Do not apply to ELF.
- Plasma/BALF LOQ 0.10 mg/L; ELF approximately 2 mg/L after urea correction. IV ELF all BLQ, no pseudo-zero points.
- Source model flagged IV plasma 3 h / IT8.24 plasma 6 h as potential outlier locations; keep all observed means.
- Endpoint window: 0.25 to 12 h
- Nominal and digitized pixel times coexist; neither is selected for a unique analysis axis. The same restriction applies to T0017–T0020. Affects: TIME_AXIS_SELECTION, NORMALIZED_TIME_CONCENTRATION_VIEW, NCA, PK_MODELING.
